# iru_ade_integration (Resource)

Manages an Apple Automated Device Enrollment integration and renewal of its Apple server token. Import by integration UUID. Creation and renewal require an Apple Business Manager token. Deletion is blocked because the Iru endpoint unassigns associated devices and the provider cannot verify a safe conditional deletion. Use lifecycle prevent_destroy=true: Terraform hides prior state for tainted resources, so create-before-destroy can otherwise attempt a new integration before deletion is refused. Retain the remote integration when removing Terraform management. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later for write-only token input.

The Apple token is write-only and is never stored in Terraform plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. Change server_token_version to renew a token; changing token bytes alone cannot produce a plan difference. Import does not need a token and sets the local version to 0. Match existing metadata and leave the token version at 0 for the first no-change import plan. Deletion is blocked because it can unassign devices. Retain the remote integration when removing Terraform management.

For inputs marked both `ephemeral` and `sensitive`, use Terraform **1.11.1 or later**. Terraform 1.11.0 has a confirmed Core serialization bug for that combination and fails planning before renewal. The original floor still supports write-only inputs; this exception is tested explicitly. See [HashiCorp issue #36603](https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform/issues/36603) and the [1.11.1 fix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hashicorp/terraform/v1.11.1/CHANGELOG.md).

Set either a default `blueprint_id`, or `use_blueprint_routing = true` with `blueprint_id` omitted. Both assignment choices are sent together for creation, renewal, and metadata updates. JSON uses an explicit null Blueprint for routing; multipart creation and renewal represent that null as an empty `blueprint_id` form field. Real API acceptance of this multipart encoding remains unverified. See the [ADE routing contract](../guides/ade-routing-contract.md) for supported getter shapes and limitations.

`email` and `phone` are sensitive in normal Terraform displays. They remain stored in plain text in state and machine-readable plan output; protect those artifacts. Outputs derived from either contact must use `sensitive = true`. Sensitivity also propagates to expressions, so these values cannot directly serve as `for_each` keys. Existing state values and schema version are unchanged; a refresh-only apply records sensitivity metadata without renewing the Apple token. This does not remove values from older state backups or historical logs.

Configure `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` as in the example. The provider
rejects observable forced/lifecycle replacements using private planning metadata,
including `-replace` without refresh. **Tainted state is a known limit**: Terraform
plans it as a fresh create without prior state/private data. Without the Core
lifecycle guard, `create_before_destroy` can create a new object before the later
DELETE refusal, leaving both for reconciliation. The provider still refuses every
remote DELETE; the Core guard and provider guard protect different stages.

Do not apply older saved replacement plans as if these new planning checks had
run. Replan with the current provider and lifecycle protection. On a partial
replacement failure, inspect both active/deposed state and remote records before
retrying; the new object must not be assumed absent. This is not permission to
delete either object or expand device/assignment scope.

## Example Usage


```terraform
resource "iru_ade_integration" "example" {
  blueprint_id         = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-4ccc-8ddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
  email                = "enrollment@example.invalid"
  phone                = "+1 555 0100"
  server_token         = filebase64("apple-server-token.p7m")
  server_token_version = 1

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String, Sensitive) Default enrollment contact email. Stored in Terraform state; redacted from normal CLI output.
- `phone` (String, Sensitive) Default enrollment contact phone. Stored in Terraform state; redacted from normal CLI output.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `blueprint_id` (String) Default Blueprint UUID. Required unless use_blueprint_routing=true; omit when using routing.
- `server_token` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Base64-encoded Apple .p7m token; use filebase64 or an ephemeral value. Required at create and when server_token_version changes. Never stored in plan or state.
- `server_token_version` (Number) Nonnegative local renewal trigger. Change this when supplying a new server_token; unchanged versions do not resend token bytes. Import defaults to 0. The version is local bookkeeping, not remotely detectable token drift.
- `use_blueprint_routing` (Boolean) Use Blueprint Routing for enrollment. Defaults to false; true requires blueprint_id to be omitted. Set both assignment choices to match the integration before importing.

### Read-Only

- `access_token_expiry` (String) Token expiration timestamp returned by Iru.
- `id` (String) ADE integration UUID.
- `server_name` (String) Apple server name returned by Iru.

## Import


```shell
terraform import iru_ade_integration.example 11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555
```


The implementation follows the [official Iru API](https://api-docs.iru.com/).
